# synesis-lsp

## Description

Role in the ecosystem: **language server** · version 0.25.0

Not run by hand: the editor starts it. Install it and the VS Code extension finds it by itself.

## Usage

```text
SYNESIS LANGUAGE SERVER (v0.25.0) | Core (v0.16.0)
Language server for knowledge engineering.

Registered Capabilities:
  LSP Core           Semantic Tokens, Hover, Completion, Definition, Rename, Inlay Hints
  Workspace          Document Synchronization, File Watching
  Synesis Graph      getRelationGraph, getCodes, getReferences, getOntologyTopics
  Synesis Engine     loadProject, validateWorkspace, getProjectStats
```

Single executable, no subcommands: the editor starts it.
